description: This file defines the SocketSender class responsible for asynchronously sending data over a socket connection, handling both single and multiple buffer sequences, and managing buffer pooling.

classes.name: SocketSender
classes.description: A class for asynchronously sending data over a socket, supporting buffer sequences and buffer pooling.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends data represented by a ReadOnlySequence over the socket, handling single and multi-segment buffers.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Overloaded method that sends a single ReadOnlyMemory buffer asynchronously.

methods.name: GetBufferList
methods.description: Converts a ReadOnlySequence into a list of ArraySegment<byte> for multi-buffer sending, utilizing buffer pooling.
